jarPublish:
- run: chmod +x java/gradlew
      # JVM parity gate: the Java unit test, alongside the transpiled vitest case.
      - name: Run JVM parity test
        working-directory: java
        run: ./gradlew :claude-code-proxy-plugin:test

      # The ProxyPlugin jar rides the same v-release. github.token (contents: write) is enough to
      # create it; the module needs no published dependency (compileOnly :routing from the submodule).
      - name: Publish proxy jar
        working-directory: java
        run: ./gradlew :claude-code-proxy-plugin:jar :claude-code-proxy-plugin:publishGithub -Partifact_version=${{ github.ref_name }} -x test -x compileTestJava
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
